name: gaussian_independent
purpose: Gaussian NB assumptions hold; linear boundary and limited-training-size comparison.

name: gaussian_correlated
purpose: Paired with gaussian_independent: duplicated evidence violates NB independence; compare F1 and log loss.

name: gaussian_unequal_variance
purpose: Same class means, different variances: Gaussian NB has a curved boundary; linear log-odds models underfit.

name: moons
purpose: Nonlinear boundary: ordinary K-NN and RBF SVM versus linear logistic/SVM.

name: circles
purpose: Radial geometry: linear boundaries fail; compare RBF gamma and local neighborhoods.

name: scale_distortion
purpose: Same rows/labels as gaussian_independent: raw versus training-standardized distances.

name: irrelevant_dimensions
purpose: Same signal and row split as gaussian_independent: effect of 80 irrelevant coordinates on K-NN and regularized models.

name: axis_aligned_rules
purpose: Two threshold rules with 5% label noise: tree interpretability, depth, pruning and forest variance.

name: imbalanced
purpose: Approximately 5% positives: majority baseline, accuracy versus precision/recall/F1 and validation threshold tuning.

name: bernoulli_binary
purpose: Binary occurrence features: Bernoulli NB including absent-feature evidence and Laplace smoothing.

name: breast_cancer
source: scikit-learn bundled breast_cancer dataset; no download required
purpose: Real binary measurements; correlated features, scaling and minority errors.

name: wine
source: scikit-learn bundled wine dataset; no download required
purpose: Real three-class data; multiclass posterior/voting and softmax evaluation.

name: digits
source: scikit-learn bundled digits dataset; no download required
purpose: Real ten-class image vectors; geometry, prediction time and multiclass evaluation.
